title: Managing Livestock on Acreage Regulations
reason: Describes the responsibilities and regulations for livestock management and transportation.

tasks.task: Explain the requirements for livestock identification and transportation.

subtasks.text: Mention that before purchasing any stock, a property identification code (PIC) is necessary.
Describe that South Wales properties carrying livestock must have a PIC, regardless of the number of animals.

tasks.task: Detail the process of identifying stock for transportation and recording movements.

subtasks.text: Note that stock must be correctly identified with the National Livestock Identification System (NLIS).
Explain that all movements of stock must be recorded on the NLIS database.

tasks.task: Describe the importance of notifying local land services about suspected livestock diseases.

subtasks.text: Highlight that livestock owners must notify local land services if they suspect or are aware of livestock diseases.

tasks.task: Emphasize the importance of understanding pasture management and feeding programs during drought.

subtasks.text: Mention that livestock owners should have a solid understanding of pasture management and feeding programs during drought.
